parameters.help_en: The tiered price for input tokens (non-cumulative). This parameter is a JSON array character string. Each element contains Tier and InputCostPointsPerMillion. Valid values for Tier: "" (default tier), 0-32K, 32K-64K, 64K-128K, 128K-256K, 256K-512K, 512K-1M, and 1M+. Example: [{"Tier":"0-32K","InputCostPointsPerMillion":"1200"}]. If this parameter is not empty, all tiers are replaced. If this parameter is not specified or an empty string is passed, the original tiers are retained. An empty array [] is not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 输入 Token 阶梯价格(非累进), JSON 数组字符串, 元素含 Tier 和 InputCostPointsPerMillion, Tier 取值 ""(默认档)/0-32K/32K-64K/64K-128K/128K-256K/256K-512K/512K-1M/1M+, 例如 [{"Tier":"0-32K","InputCostPointsPerMillion":"1200"}]; 非空时整体替换全部档位, 不传或传空字符串保留原档位, 不可传 []
parameters.name: input_token_tiers
